title: History field lifecycle support
objective: Define current/old state variable buffers and converged-step commit routines for plasticity history.
implementation_steps: Define HistoryFields class with current and old buffers
Store: equivalent plastic strain (alpha), back stress (if needed), plastic strain tensor
Implement commit(): copy current → old on converged step
Implement rollback(): restore current from old on non-convergence
Write step-commit tests confirming rollback/commit correctness
acceptance_criteria: After rollback: current restored to last committed old

cases: Update + commit: old matches updated current
Update + rollback: current restored to old

risks: Memory layout must be compatible with Taichi fields — use ti.field for GPU support
